Alex Chen: Quick follow-up to the RFC. I'm proposing a 'fastpath' onboarding pass: super-quick checks that give devs feedback in ~30s. Not a replacement for fullbench, just a quick smoke to catch obvious compatibility and immediate perf/OOM issues. Thoughts?

Priya Patel: Sounds helpful. What do you want in that 30s window?

Alex Chen: Keep it minimal: manifest sanity (shapes, entrypoint), tokenizer roundtrip on a few short prompts, tiny microbench (10 warmup steps, short seq, small batch), and a KV-cache layout probe. No heavy evals.

Jon B.: Add a synthetic KV replay check. We had models that worked until kv cache hit and then kernels misbehaved. A tiny synthetic helps.

Marta G: Concern: noisy failures will frustrate teams. Recommend we label outcomes clearly (PASS / WARN / FAIL). If FAIL, surface exact failing check and provide a single-click re-run. Also make fastpath advisory first.

Sam R: Ops: emit p50/p95 for tokenizer+inference, mem_peak, and a kv_shape_mismatch boolean. Tag metrics with model_sha, runner, and fastpath_run_id. Rollout plan: advisory -> soft-block (warning, manual override) -> hard-block.

onboard-bot: scheduled advisory runs for new uploads starting 2024-06-05.

Priya Patel: We should also compute a small compat signature (vocab-hash, dtype, kv-dims, layer-count) and store it on the model artifact. Quick check in gateway can reject obvious mismatches.

Alex Chen: Agreed. I'll draft compat_signature_v1 fields. It must be deterministic and small.

Jon B.: For microbenching focus: kernel-selection/warmup time rather than full throughput. 10-step warmup with telemetry hooks will catch many regressions. Also randomize input seeds (5 small seeds) to reduce false-negatives.

Marta G: Ownership question: where to put fastpath code? My vote: single shared tiny library (libs/onboard-smoke) consumed by console, gateway, and runtime via a lightweight CLI shim. Avoid duplicating test logic.

Alex Chen: Proposed CLI shape:
redwood-onboard --model ./model.tar.gz --fastpath --checks meta,tokenize,kv,warmup --timeout 30s --out /tmp/fp.json
Output: status=PASS|WARN|FAIL, failing_checks=[], compat_signature. Keep output simple.

Sam R: Integration: push status to model-registry.last_fastpath_status, emit metrics to graphite/prom, store minimal artifacts (sample tokens, tiny logs) for 30d. Metrics kept long-term.

Priya Patel: Thresholds: tokenization mismatch -> WARN (unless >3 mismatches -> FAIL), kv_shape_mismatch -> FAIL, warmup_latency > baseline*3 -> WARN, mem_peak > node_limit -> FAIL. We can refine after data.

Jon B.: For the KV synthetic, make sure it only validates layout and size, not exact content, so it's fast and deterministic.

Marta G: I'll draft a dev UX playbook: how to interpret results, re-run flow, and support escalation. Also include opt-out for community uploads.

Alex Chen: Action items:
- Priya: compat_signature_v1 schema (fields + hash alg) by EOW.
- Jon: PoC of kv-synthetic + 10-step warmup harness by Tue.
- Marta: rollout playbook + UX doc by next Fri.
- Sam: metrics/registry wiring + retention plan by Wed.

Alex Chen: Plan to run advisory fastpath automatically for new uploads; after we gather signal we move to soft-block. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

onboard-bot: ack - fastpath advisory enabled.
